
# Under --detect-witness-matching-loops, an existential under a universal whose witness re-matches the universal's trigger, as in a subset-type invariant forall q | q in below :: exists p :: p in below && q < p, gets the matching-loop warning, and quantifiers whose nested variables are universal get none (https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/202).
git-issues/github-issue-202.dfy
